sources.name: Call of Duty: Zombies Guides — interactive map
sources.note: Area labels and service coordinates from the public map, paired with its 2048 × 2048 Activision background (/layers/kowakujo/kowakujo-main-map.webp). The separate Mister Peeks marker group supplies Cursed reward spawn candidates, distinct from music, relic and doll quests.

sources.name: Call of Duty — Kowakujō tactical map
sources.note: Official 4096-unit marker coordinates are normalized to the un-cropped tactical overview. Area guidance uses those landmarks and the guide’s room descriptions.

layers.label: Overview

targets.title: Build the Maneki-Neko and obtain Nekomancer
targets.description: Room guidance for the parts, crafting bench, cat sequence and World Seed; moving paw prints are not fixed pins.

targets.title: Lantern search areas and War Room
targets.description: Search the eleven lantern landmarks in the guide. Central Courtyard contains two lanterns; the map marks rooms, not verified lantern positions.

targets.title: Fox Mask and mask wall
targets.description: Use the Ninja Kite above the crafting bench, then bring the mask to Storage Rooms. Roof pickup and wall positions are not surveyed.

targets.title: Suspect evidence search areas
targets.description: Pipe near Workshop stairs; comb at Wunderfizz; case at Elemental Pop; place the evidence in Meditation Room.

targets.title: Merchant evidence
targets.description: Activate the Coin Purse in spawn, get the apple zombie in Kitchens, then bring it to the Staging Area window. The gold-plaque Mystery Box varies.

targets.title: Bucket and Gardener evidence
targets.description: Bucket candidates are Tea Garden or the upper floor of Onsen Baths. Fill it and water the Flower Garden plants.

targets.title: Noble windows
targets.description: Look above the Tea Garden entrance from the Training Area.

targets.title: Monkshood preparation
targets.description: Collect the pouch and plant near the Training Area, plant at Tenshu Entrance, and use a cherry blossom tree buff. Active fissures move between areas.

targets.title: Pestle and Pufferfish
targets.description: Collect the Pestle from Storage Rooms, complete the Kitchen bowl, then return the evidence.

targets.title: Location evidence rooms
targets.description: Three soul-box areas. The dog can move away from Tea Garden.

targets.title: Motive evidence
targets.description: The Netsuke statue appears at Stables. The Hanko drops from a roaming Oni and has no fixed spawn pin.

targets.title: Clock and numbered flag areas
targets.description: Clock in Storage Rooms; numbered areas are Stables (1), Flower Garden (2), Central Courtyard (3), Outer Ward (4).

targets.title: Saka Cup preparation
targets.description: Collect the shards, finish the poison evidence, and repair the cup on the Tea Garden table.

targets.title: Murder puzzle and witness traps
targets.description: Evidence paintings are in Meditation Room. The witness can require a different Ghostly Riflemen trap.

targets.title: Onryo start and battle area
targets.description: Charge the orb, follow it to the World Seed, then fight the Onryo in the Central Courtyard.

targets.title: Travel to Nyxara
targets.description: Use the three-fish pole by Pack-a-Punch or the fast travel unlocked after Onryo. The separate volcano arena is not drawn on this overview.

targets.title: Bell search candidates
targets.description: Look at the sunken Stables house or above the Warden wall-buy.

targets.title: Mystery Box search
targets.description: Find the box location with the gold plaque for the Coin Purse. The active box moves.

targets.title: Maneki-Neko workbench
targets.description: Bench near Vulture Aid in Workshop.

targets.title: Mister Peeks — Cursed reward spawns
targets.description: In tiered Cursed runs, Mister Peeks can briefly appear at a possible spawn. Shoot him for an egg with rewards that can include perks. These pins are candidates, not guaranteed appearances.
